Ukulele Chord Chart Generator

Real ukulele chord diagrams in GCEA tuning — 34 standard shapes with finger numbers, barres, X/O. Download as PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a chord from the list (GCEA tuning).
  2. Check the diagram — fingers, barres, muted/open strings.
  3. Click "Download PNG" to save the chart.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How many chords are included?

34 standard GCEA shapes: major, minor, 7th, maj7, m7 and sus chords — with correct fingers and barre marks.

Which tuning?

Standard GCEA (g-C-E-A). Every shape is for this tuning.

Is the PNG high quality?

Yes — the chart renders at 2× resolution for a crisp, print-ready image.
